text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Drizzle...

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
Water, water everywhere... and the rain's
only
getting stronger.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
The forecast says there's a huge storm
coming, so
we won't be able to train
outside.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I check the news, only to see reports of

record-breaking winds and rain
throughout the
country.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: I have a bad feeling about this...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The storm leaves its mark everywhere it
goes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Not even the URA Finale is safe...

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Enough! I'll go and negotiate myself! I'll
make this
happen, no matter what!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Director, please! That's not going to
help!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Ah... Trainer. You see, the thing is...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
The URA Finale might have to be called
off...

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
You are aware that racecourses are
made of turf,
yes?

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
That turf is grown on one of a small
number of
designated farms and then
laid on the track.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
However, I have just been told that the
recent
stormy weather has ruined the
turf we were
growing...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
That turf was intended for the URA
Finale.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
For safety reasons, the track surface
must be
replaced before the race.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
However, with the replacement turf
destroyed...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I suppose it would be possible to restrict
the
event to dirt tracks, but—

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Inconceivable! That's no good at all! The URA Finale is meant to give every Umamusume a chance at glory!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Director...

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Determination! I will make it happen by
any
means necessary!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: I will not betray the Umamusume who have worked so hard for this race... or the fans who have supported them!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
I set out to give every Umamusume a
chance to
shine! Until that goal is
fulfilled, I will not stop!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Ah! Director?!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: I wonder what she's planning...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
This is hardly out of character for her,
but I hope
she doesn't push herself too
far.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
It's hard not to be, isn't it? Ever since I
first met
her, she's always been a force
of nature.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Her mother, the former director, is an
exceptional
woman.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Her expertise regarding Umamusume
was actively
sought after not only in
Japan, but all over the
world...
Eventually, she decided to move her

focus overseas.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Considering her daughter's young age,
the plan
was originally for somebody
else to succeed her
as director.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
However, Miss Akikawa spoke up and
asked to
take over herself.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
She won the position with a speech that
would
rival any adult.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
It truly was inspiring, you know.
Everyone who
heard it could feel the
breadth of her knowledge,
the clarity of
her vision...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
...and above all, the depth of her love
for
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
She might look immature, and she can
certainly
act chaotically at times, but her
feelings for
Umamusume are genuine.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
She poured all that love into planning
this race...
and now it might come to
nothing.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: We do.
choice_data_list: I really want to make it happen, no matter what...!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: I'll rack my brain for a solution.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
So please, I would appreciate any help
you can
give.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The URA Finale... canceled? Hopefully,
we can
find a way to stop that from
happening, but...
what can we possibly
do?
